{{Gem|137}}, {{TimeScaleTicket|4}}, {{Exp|440}} & 2 [[Nuke]]s ([[All Paths]]) }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|All enemies have high defenses, tank and bloated modifiers.|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Juggernaut''' is a challenge map, which uses [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode as its mode. Triumphing on this map rewards the player with {{Gem|125}}, {{TimeScaleTicket|4}}, {{Exp|400}} and two [[Nuke]]s. However, the rewards can be higher if modifiers that affect rewards are present. Like with other challenges, rewards can only be claimed once a week. ==Changes== '''Juggernaut''' has three main changes to enemies, applying the [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attribute to multiple enemies, increasing every enemy's defense by 50% and giving every enemy the [[Bloated]] attribute. On the earlier waves, it also spaces out the enemy spawns. Cash is also altered on this challenge. ===Tank=== The [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attribute is only applied to these enemies when they spawn in naturally: *[[Abnormal]] *[[Quick]] *[[Heavy]] *[[Abnormal Boss]] *[[Shadow]] *[[Mystery]] *[[Dark Necromancer]] **Removed on Wave 26, re-added for every wave after. *[[Hazard]] ===Health=== While the challenge and modifier claim to add the [[Bloated]] attribute, this is not the only change related to enemy health. A few select enemies have their own preset health values that are not the same as [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode but doubled. These values are still doubled, making these enemies mostly have higher health than in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, with some exceptions. *[[Abnormal]] - 12 health ({{Color|Yes|+4}}) *[[Quick]] - 8 health ({{Color|No|-2}}) *[[Heavy]] - ===Cash=== There are two changes made to cash, first is starting cash. It is {{Money|300}} higher than in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. Additionally, the wave bonus is also increased. It is calculated as: :({{Money|90}} - ((Players - 1) × 10)) + Waves Completed × ({{Money|450}} - ((Players - 1) × 50)) The wave clear bonus appears when every enemy from that wave was killed. It is 35% of the wave bonus in solo, while for duo and trio it is 20%. ==Strategy== *Compared to regular [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, the wave bonus is boosted heavily, meaning you will gain more cash overall and can allow yourself to bring more expensive towers. *As all enemies that appear before Wave 20 are tank enemies, towers effective at killing these enemies are heavily recommended. **Units can be quite effective, as they will deal full damage to them. The [[Military Base]] is most effective at this stage, due to its cheap cost. **As the [[Trapper]]'s spike and bear traps deal collision damage, it can be extremely effective here. **If using the [[Military Base]], you may want to place down the [[Military Base]] and wait a bit before starting the match. As the unit timer is active on Wave 0, you can wait for it to go down, allowing the [[Military Base]] to send out a [[Humvee]] instantly, or multiple if you wait long enough. **Multiple [[Shotgunner]]s are quite effective, as each bullet the [[Shotgunner]] fires deals one damage. *Defense dropping towers are very useful here, as every enemy has at least 50% defense here. **Defense dropping is not that important early on, as while some enemies like the [[Abnormal Boss]] have defense comparable to late game enemies like [[Fallen Guardian]], these enemies are also tanks, meaning damage dealt to them is always reduced to 1. **The [[Pyromancer]] can be very effective, due to its high defense dropping and quick tick rate. **The [[Cryomancer]] can be effective here, as it can reduce defense and slow down enemies. *After Wave 19, the only new enemy to be a tank is [[Hazard]], meaning that towers that would not be as effective against tank enemies can be used.
